judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, handles missing per-round usage without `NaN` or data loss, and satisfies every acceptance criterion from the issue. Its core implementation (`totalUsage` and `addUsage`) is nearly identical to the reference's `accumulateUsage`, and adding the `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` directly addresses the ticket's prompt to make the type unambiguous. However, unlike the reference, the candidate creates two separate, largely duplicate test files (`chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts` and `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`) plus a `.lore/dod.md` artifact instead of adding the cases to the existing `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` suite. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate updated the bullet in place under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading rather than moving it into the main spec section and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
